summary.zh: Game Jam 团队项目，通过自定义 Unity Shader 将平面场景投射到球面，形成独特的空间体验。
summary.en: A Game Jam team project using a custom Unity shader to project a planar scene onto a sphere and create a distinctive spatial experience.

zh: 将平面场景投射至球面
en: Project the planar scene onto a sphere

en: Organized a small team and authored a Unity shader that projected the planar scene onto a sphere.
